expected_performance.subset_definition: BRISC images whose nearest internal TRAINING image is more than perceptual-hash Hamming distance 5 away. The other 56 percent of BRISC 2025 is near-duplicate of the training data and is excluded.
_caveats: These numbers are from the CLEAN subset of BRISC 2025 only. About 56 percent of BRISC is near-duplicate of the training data and was excluded. Full-BRISC numbers are training accuracy, not external.

Image-level duplication is excluded. PATIENT-level leakage cannot be ruled out: neither dataset ships patient identifiers, so other slices from the same patients may still be in training. The clean subset is therefore an upper bound on true external performance.

Class balance in the clean subset is not the same as full BRISC. PPV and NPV measured here do not transfer to a clinic. Use sensitivity and specificity and the prevalence projections in OPERATING_POINT.md.
BRISC is entirely T1 across three planes. Performance on other sequences is unmeasured.
tumor_miss_rate here is argmax-based: a real tumour displayed as notumor. binary_sensitivity uses the p_tumor threshold.

notes: entropy_defer_threshold is in nats and is compared against the predictive entropy of the MC-Dropout mean over mc_T passes.
temperature is applied as softmax(log(mean_probs)/T); it does not change the predicted class, only the displayed confidence.
tumor_threshold is applied to p_tumor = p_glioma + p_meningioma + p_pituitary AFTER temperature scaling.
Every threshold here was fitted on the internal validation split and applied to BRISC unchanged.

clinic_operating_point.chosen_for: a clinic with no on-site radiologist
clinic_operating_point.supersedes: p_tumor 0.970 with four-way-entropy deferral at 0.0378, which deferred 41.2% of scans and 61.8% of unseen healthy scans, and which locked the confidence display to 'Low' for every answer because no call could ever be 0.25 away from a 0.970 threshold.

defer_threshold_fitted_with: app.core.model.run_mc_dropout on internal_val, i.e. the exact quantity the app computes at inference time

defer_threshold_history.why_it_was_wrong: Fitted on the prediction caches, where mutual_information is one model's value from 20 MC passes. The app pools posterior samples across all 5 ensemble members, so its mutual information has a much heavier tail. The old cutoff sat inside that tail and deferred 31% of unseen scans.
defer_threshold_history.why_this_value: Measured on 800 unseen BRISC images: deferring 5.6% and deferring 33.6% both send home the same 1 tumour in 422. Extra deferral bought no safety at all, and cost 28 points of usability. This is the tightest budget on that flat stretch.
